notes.title: Game will be free to download
notes.notes: Due to the player to reflect the game to download to charge, at the same time there are props in the game charge, so the recent game will be free to download.

notes.title: new
notes.notes: In response to player feedback, we've made a lot of changes to the game, redesigning the guide missions, taverns, generals, daily missions, item properties, etc. Hopefully these changes will lead to a better gaming experience for players.

notes.title: update 2017-1-7
notes.notes:
The updates are mainly fixes:
1. The UI works well under different screen resolution.
2. The incomplete translation of the game was further fixed

notes.title: The new update
notes.notes: Feedback to players,1. We have revised some parts of the interface where the translation is incomplete2. Added the option of full screen (click on the icon in the upper left corner of the game to set it to full screen)
